rapport_notes: Very patient and warm with an anxious, talkative customer (recent widow) who asked many detailed packing-material questions; never showed impatience.
process_discipline_notes: Pitch never reached the standard differentiator recitation (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) because the call got absorbed into detailed packing-cost/material Q&A before the rep could deliver it.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "aside from packing this important item to you, do you have any other concerns or important things that you wanted to answer during this call?" -- asked right after quid pro quo, and acknowledged the concern the customer had already raised (professional packers for delicate/expensive items).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised two real concerns (needing careful/professional packing for delicate items, and "money is an object... I've got to keep this down as low as I possibly can") but the rep only acknowledged each before pivoting straight into pricing -- no follow-up questions like "tell me more."
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the five Save-Your-Ass lines were delivered -- the pitch got diverted into a packing-materials Q&A before reaching them.

top_strength: Never lost patience or warmth despite a very long, meandering, detail-heavy call from a customer explicitly worried about cost and fragile items.
coaching_note: The customer explicitly raised a budget concern and a fragile-items concern, but got no real follow-up questions, and the call never reached the no-worry-damage-coverage or Meet-Your-Mover differentiators before the price was revealed -- losing the sale on a $4,152 quote after a $4,000ish price anchor from her prior mover suggests value wasn't built before the number landed.
